tools_helpful.evidence: Turn 44/48/52 — caught the manifest defects (missing assets, Windows.Universal target, missing rescap:runFullTrust) and the startup crash via smoke-launch, each with a concrete fix hint; drove the agent to a clean PASS.
Turn 49-50 — surfaced exception code 0xc000027b in Microsoft.UI.Xaml.dll, which pointed the agent at the XAML, not the entry point.

tools_problematic.problem: Anchor lookups failed for plausible names
tools_problematic.evidence: Turn 45-46 — `-Anchor manifest` and `-Anchor appxmanifest` both returned `Anchor '#manifest' not found` / `'#appxmanifest' not found`; the real anchors are `#csproj` plus the un-id'd `### Package.appxmanifest …` / `### Manifest migration checklist` H3 headings, which have no `<a id>` so are not addressable by the lookup script.

tool_limitations.limitation: Only resolves explicit `<a id=...>` anchors; the manifest patterns the validator points users to (image reconcile, Windows.Desktop+runFullTrust checklist) are H3 headings with no anchor id, so the script can't fetch them.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Add an `<a id="manifest">` (and alias to the checklist) so `-Anchor manifest` resolves, matching what the validator tells the agent to look up.

doc_errors.wrong: States 0xC000027B is 'Often a legacy projection/activation incompatibility for an API used at startup. If the API/contract is unsupported on the current OS, defer it.' — steering the reader toward deferring an API.
doc_errors.correct: When the faulting module is Microsoft.UI.Xaml.dll, 0xC000027B is most often a XAML parse/load failure (invalid RelativePanel.Below/Above/RightOf/LeftOf target not in the same panel, missing StaticResource/ThemeResource key, or a broken MergedDictionary), not an unsupported API. Inspect the XAML before deferring anything.

errors_encountered.error: CS9035: Required member 'Scenario.Title' / 'Scenario.ClassType' must be set in the object initializer (in generated XamlTypeInfo.g.cs)
errors_encountered.root_cause: Agent marked the SDK-sample `Scenario` model class (SampleConfiguration.cs) properties as `required` to silence nullable warnings under <Nullable>enable</Nullable>. The XAML compiler's generated XamlTypeInfo.g.cs constructs `new Scenario()` with no initializer, which cannot satisfy `required` members.
errors_encountered.fix: Drop `required`; give the XAML-referenced model properties default initializers (`public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;`, `public Type ClassType { get; set; } = typeof(object);`) or keep them nullable.

errors_encountered.root_cause: MainPage.xaml placed `SampleTitle` (TextBlock) in a separate Grid-header StackPanel while the `ScenarioControl` ListBox in the RelativePanel still used `RelativePanel.Below="SampleTitle"`. A RelativePanel alignment/position attribute may only target a sibling inside the SAME RelativePanel; a dangling name reference throws at XAML load, before the window shows.
errors_encountered.fix: Move `SampleTitle` into the RelativePanel so the `RelativePanel.Below` target is a sibling within the panel (or remove the cross-panel RelativePanel reference).

errors_encountered.error: Validator FAIL: Package.appxmanifest 4 missing `-sdk` images, TargetDeviceFamily=Windows.Universal, missing rescap namespace + runFullTrust
errors_encountered.root_cause: Agent carried the UWP sample manifest forward verbatim; UWP samples brand assets with a `-sdk` suffix and target Windows.Universal without runFullTrust.
errors_encountered.fix: Repoint image refs to scaffold assets, set TargetDeviceFamily=Windows.Desktop, add rescap namespace + <rescap:Capability Name="runFullTrust"/>. (Skill already documents this under the manifest H3s.)

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Build flipped from succeed (with nullable warnings) to FAIL CS9035 after adding `required`, then recovered.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: No guidance that `required` collides with the XAML source generator's parameterless construction of model types referenced from XAML.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A 'Common build errors' pattern naming CS9035 on XAML-referenced model classes and prescribing default initializers instead of `required`.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Clean build but app died at launch with 0xc000027b; the skill's 0xC000027B row pointed at 'defer the API', which did not apply.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: ~4 turns (event-log capture + XAML inspection + fix + re-validate)
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Startup-crash table maps 0xC000027B only to legacy-projection/defer-the-API, omitting the common XAML-load cause (here a cross-panel RelativePanel reference).
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Read events 1000/1026, saw faulting module Microsoft.UI.Xaml.dll, inspected MainPage.xaml, moved SampleTitle into the RelativePanel.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Adding the XAML-load failure cause (invalid RelativePanel target / missing resource / broken MergedDictionary) to the 0xC000027B guidance.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Two failed anchor lookups (`manifest`, `appxmanifest`) before the agent gave up and edited the manifest from the validator's inline hint.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Manifest patterns are H3 headings with no `<a id>`, so the anchor script can't fetch them even though the validator names them.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Agent used the validator's inline fix text directly.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Add an `<a id="manifest">` anchor over the manifest patterns so the script can resolve the name the validator already advertises.

env_issues.issue: No altimeter device on the host; sensor buttons disabled in both UWP and WinUI apps.
env_issues.workaround: Both apps show 'No altimeter found' / 'No data'; parity confirmed structurally. Not a migration issue.
